item.title: Arijit Singh announces shocking retirement from playback singing
item.description: Bollywood’s soulful playback singer Arijit Singh announced today that he is retiring from playback singing in films. The singer, known for his emotional renditions, revealed the news on his social media accounts. In a statement shared online, Arijit Singh said, “I am not gonna be taking any new assignments as a playback vocalist from now on. item.title: Billlie kicks of 2026 with dreamy pre-release single 'cloud palace ~ false awakening' — listen
item.description: Billlie is back, and they’re starting 2026 with a bang! The MYSTIC STORY K-pop group has released their pre-release single, 'cloud palace ~ false awakening', a track that continues their intricate storytelling within their "palace" trilogy. Following their second and third mini-albums the collective soul and unconscious: chapter one and the Billage of perception: chapter two, this single brings a mysterious, dream-like soundscape to life, making it the perfect introduction to their new chapter.

item.title: Palm Tree Music Festival Singapore announces John Summit, Alesso, Layton Giordani & MaRLo
item.description: Palm Tree Music Festival Singapore has officially unveiled its first wave of artists — and it’s shaping up to be a high-energy EDM affair. Set to take place on 18 April, the festival’s Singapore debut at The Meadow, Gardens by the Bay will be headlined by John Summit, with Alesso joining the bill as a special guest.
